description: This script refactors autoname (auto-incrementing or naming series) settings for DocTypes in an ERPNext system, updating property setters for autoname series based on existing configurations.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function that retrieves series to set and updates property setters accordingly.

methods.name: set_series
methods.description: Updates or creates a property setter for a given DocType to set its autoname series.

methods.name: get_series
methods.description: Gathers DocTypes that need their autoname series updated based on existing configurations.

methods.name: get_series_to_preserve
methods.description: Retrieves the current autoname series for a specific DocType to preserve existing configuration.
